nodes.label: /me empty-state copy stays wrong after the user is rostered
nodes.rationale: The condition keys off zero upcoming+results without checking team membership, conflating 'not rostered' with 'rostered but no fixtures scheduled'.

nodes.label: Public spectator header drops its nav links at 390px
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the marketing-site mobile nav gap — either one shared header component or the same missing pattern implemented twice.

nodes.label: FAB reproduces on logged-out public pages
nodes.rationale: Appearing with no console/account context proves the FAB is mounted at the root layout level, so it is one shared fix rather than three page-specific ones.

nodes.label: 'Time TBD' shown above an already-live scorebug
nodes.rationale: The scheduled-time label only makes sense pre-match; once status is live it contradicts the scorebug directly beneath it.

nodes.label: TV slideshow route renders an interactive help FAB
nodes.rationale: A kiosk view meant to run unattended has no use for a clickable chat launcher at all — suppression, not repositioning, is the right fix here.

nodes.label: Dev magic-link login mechanic for audit sessions
nodes.rationale: POST /api/auth/magic-link returns login_url directly in dev; tokens expire quickly so a fresh one must be requested per session.
